# flagsetup

```go
import "github.com/shdeen/bildomat/tools/flagsetup"
```

Command flagsetup generates the parameter flag records of internal/params from their one source document, internal/params/config/paramflags.json.

It runs from the go:generate directive in internal/params/flag.go, never at run time, and writes internal/params/zz\_paramflags.go: one function returning the records as a Go literal.

Validation: a malformed document, content after the document, a flag ID declared twice, an alias declared twice, and a data type outside string, number, integer, and boolean all fail generation, and nothing is written.

The generator imports nothing from this module. internal/params does not compile while its generated file is missing or broken, so a generator that imported it could not run to repair it. Its diagnostic constants must first be generated by copygen, which also imports no application package.

<a name="generatedHeader"></a>The generated file's fixed source fragments.

```go
const (
    generatedHeader = "// Code generated by flagsetup from internal/params/config/paramflags.json. DO NOT EDIT.\n\n" +
        "package params\n\n" +
        "// ParamFlags returns the parameter flag records, one per generation parameter,\n" +
        "// in the order the parameter flag document declares them. Every call builds a\n" +
        "// new slice, so no caller's change reaches another caller.\n" +
        "func ParamFlags() []ParamFlag {\n\treturn []ParamFlag{\n"
    generatedFooter = "\t}\n}\n"

    recordOpening          = "\t\t{\n"
    recordClosing          = "\t\t},\n"
    identityFieldsForm     = "\t\t\tFlagID: %q,\n\t\t\tFlagName: %q,\n\t\t\tDataType: %q,\n"
    aliasesFieldForm       = "\t\t\tAliases: %#v,\n"
    descriptionFieldForm   = "\t\t\tDescription: %q,\n"
    exampleValuesFieldForm = "\t\t\tExampleValues: %#v,\n"
    commentFieldForm       = "\t\t\tComment: %q,\n"
    textHintFieldForm      = "\t\t\tTextHint: %q,\n"
    allowMultipleField     = "\t\t\tAllowMultiple: true,\n"
)
```

## Variables

<a name="errParamFlags"></a>Sentinels of the parameter flag document.

- errParamFlags is the category root for a broken parameter flag document. A document that cannot be read, and generated source that cannot be formatted or written, wrap it beside the failure's own cause.
- errParamFlagsDecode marks a document that failed to decode.
- errParamFlagsTrailing marks content after the document.
- errParamFlagsInvalid marks a decoded document with invalid content.

```go
var (
    errParamFlags         = errors.New("param-flag")
    errParamFlagsDecode   = fmt.Errorf("%w: decode failed", errParamFlags)
    errParamFlagsTrailing = fmt.Errorf("%w: trailing content after the enumeration document", errParamFlagsDecode)
    errParamFlagsInvalid  = fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid content", errParamFlags)
)
```

<a name="generate"></a>
## func [generate](<https://github.com/shdeen/bildomat-dev/blob/main/tools/flagsetup/flagsetup.go#L102>)

```go
func generate(sourcePath, targetPath string) error
```

generate takes the path of the parameter flag document and the path of the Go source file to write, and writes the records the document declares. A document that does not decode or fails validation returns its classification error. A document that cannot be read, and generated source that cannot be formatted or written, return the category error wrapping the cause. Nothing is written on any failure.

<a name="renderSource"></a>
## func [renderSource](<https://github.com/shdeen/bildomat-dev/blob/main/tools/flagsetup/flagsetup.go#L186>)

```go
func renderSource(records []flagRecord) string
```

renderSource takes the records and returns the Go source of the generated file, before formatting. A key the document leaves out is left out of the record's literal, so the field keeps the zero value an absent key decodes to; a list the document declares empty stays an empty list.

<a name="flagRecord"></a>
## type [flagRecord](<https://github.com/shdeen/bildomat-dev/blob/main/tools/flagsetup/flagsetup.go#L77-L87>)

flagRecord is one record of the parameter flag document. Its fields mirror the document's keys, which are also the fields of parameters.ParamFlag.

- FlagID: the parameter's canonical flag name
- FlagName: the parameter name shown to users
- DataType: the parameter's value type
- Aliases: alternate flag names
- Description: the parameter description shown in help output
- ExampleValues: example values shown in help output
- Comment: additional parameter guidance shown in help output
- TextHint: the value placeholder shown in help output
- AllowMultiple: whether the parameter accepts multiple values

```go
type flagRecord struct {
    FlagID        string   `json:"flagID"`
    FlagName      string   `json:"flagName"`
    DataType      string   `json:"dataType"`
    Aliases       []string `json:"aliases"`
    Description   string   `json:"description"`
    ExampleValues []string `json:"exampleValues"`
    Comment       string   `json:"comment"`
    TextHint      string   `json:"textHint"`
    AllowMultiple bool     `json:"allowMultiple"`
}
```

<a name="readRecords"></a>
### func [readRecords](<https://github.com/shdeen/bildomat-dev/blob/main/tools/flagsetup/flagsetup.go#L132>)

```go
func readRecords(sourcePath string, document []byte) ([]flagRecord, error)
```

readRecords takes the path of the parameter flag document, which its errors name, and the document's bytes, and returns the document's records. It returns the decode error for a malformed document or an unknown key, the trailing\-content error for anything after the document, and the invalid\-content error for a flag ID declared twice, an alias declared twice, or an unsupported data type.
